bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 411,000 views on one reel. Everything you sell is a product.
beats.text: One of your reels passed 411,000 views, you have 29,100 YouTube subscribers and 22,100 on Instagram. What people can buy is stickers, binders, trays and a membership.

beats.title: Your story is the reason they follow you.
beats.text: You paid off 15 maxed-out credit cards and say so openly. People living paycheck to paycheck see themselves in that, and your “Comment ‘Dine’” challenges show they want to be guided.

beats.title: Stickers don't pay off debt. Guidance does.
beats.text: Your audience's real problem is debt and no savings, and the shop sells them tools. The people who want you to walk them through it have nowhere to go, so every sale is a small one.

beats.title: “I'm not a financial advisor.” You don't need to be.
beats.text: You coach habits and systems from your own experience: cash budgeting, savings challenges, a payoff order. No investment advice, exactly what you already share, with people accountable to you.
beats.quote: “Having overcome 15 maxed-out credit cards, no savings, and a complete lack of budgeting, I know firsthand how challenging it can be to regain financial control.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have your monthly income and a list of your debts (balance and minimum payment) ready.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Tina

preCallEmails.subject: I had 15 maxed-out cards
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

I know what it feels like when every card is full and nothing is left at the end of the month.

What got me out was a cash budget, small savings wins and a payoff order. That's what we'll build for you.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Tina

preCallEmails.subject: "I already use the savings challenges"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Love that, that's a great start.

The programme adds the plan around them: your budget, your payoff order and weekly check-ins.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Tina

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Tina

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Tina's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Tina

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Tina
